meta: Photos taken on the bed, with a messy background and poor light, make shoppers scroll past. AI helps Mark redo his product photos, as long as they still match the real item.

muc.title: Photos taken at home
muc.text: Mark photographs his silk scarf right on the bed, with a messy background and dim light. It doesn't make anyone want to buy.

muc.title: Remove and replace the background
muc.text: Bit shows him: AI tools now remove the background in one click, then place the product on a clean white background, or a scene that suits the customer.

muc.title: Fix the light, sharpen
muc.text: AI also fixes brightness, balances color and sharpens blurry photos, work that used to need someone who knew photo editing.

muc.title: Virtual model photos
muc.text: You can make photos of a virtual model using the product, so shoppers can picture it. It's best to say clearly that it's an illustration.

muc.title: Photos must match the real item
muc.text: The most important rule: photos must look like the real item. Change the color or over-beautify, and customers will be disappointed when it arrives, return it and leave bad reviews.

muc.title: Redo your main photo
muc.text: Reshoot your main product on a plain background with window light, then use AI to remove the background and fix the light for your main photo.
